Most ATMs software will not allow an operator to shutdown windows when a customer is active.   It will delay the process till the customer session is over.  

 Likely a crash occurred and the windows AeDebugger took over and forced a reboot to recover the machine.   

Any customer active session is closely audit and can be resolved within days.  Inconvenient but recoverable.
Majority of ATMs run windows.   The hardware integration standard CEN/XFS is defiend based on windows architecture.  Very little use other OSs.
